---

### 3. Core causes of the rise in complaints

#### Cause 1: the double-compensation policy heightened customers' attention to turnaround

The new policy stipulates that an overdue refund is **automatically compensated at double the amount**, which makes customers highly sensitive to refund turnaround. As soon as a customer perceives any delay (even a purely psychological one), they proactively complain to trigger the double-compensation mechanism. In other words, part of the rise in complaints is because **customers' awareness of their rights was stimulated by the new policy**, not because actual processing turnaround worsened. [cite:http://shoresummit-notice.example/refund-policy-new]

- which scenarios can be handled directly after the limit was raised;
- the formal requirements for cc'ing for the record;
- an accurate understanding of the conditions that trigger double compensation.

Customers know that an overdue refund earns double compensation, so there is a motive to **deliberately manufacture complaints to trigger compensation**.
